standard: ASME B18.8.2 hardened ground machine dowel pins

Dowel Pin Sizes Chart - first table (same structure as engineersedge, counted with it as ONE source)
ANSI B18.8.2 Specifications dowel pin (5 tables of 3 sizes each; symbols d, d1, c, R)
ANSI machine dowel pins chart (transposed table, all 15 sizes)
vendor product data sheet 'Dowel Pin Standard Series' (standard series A, B, C only; corroboration)
vendor spec sheet dowel pins standard series 1/8..1 (corroboration; same catalogue template as purchasepartners.com Dowell.pdf)

dropped.why: mislabelled: its 'actual pin dia max' equals the basic value (0.0627 not 0.0628) and 'oversize max' equals the oversize basic (0.0635); not used

dropped.what: Single shear load and suggested press-fit hole columns
dropped.why: not needed for drawing; only 2 independent HTML sources (engineersedge, hdw) for 1/16-3/32

dropped.what: Taper pins (1/48 taper) and spring/roll pins of ASME B18.8.2
dropped.why: family names three pin types; only the dowel pin (clearly defined single type) was tabulated

checks: A_std_max = A_std_basic + 0.0001 and A_std_min = basic - 0.0001 for all 15 sizes
Oversize basic = standard basic + 0.0008 (oversize series is +0.001 over nominal vs +0.0002) for all sizes
point diameter B max < A_std_min and B max > B min; crown height C max > crown radius R min
all numeric columns strictly increase with nominal size
d_nom is the rounded decimal of the fraction (3/32=0.0938, 5/32=0.1562) as printed in the tables
all 15 rows compared cell by cell: engineersedge, amesweb, fullerfasteners, hdw.com.tw agree on every number; vendor PDFs agree for the cells they list
shape_hint: A plain solid cylindrical rod with no head and no thread; one end has a chamfer (point diameter B, angle roughly 4-16 deg) and the other end is domed/crowned (crown height C, crown radius R). Overall length is chosen by the buyer; the diameter is ground to a tight tolerance for press fit.

role_map.size: nominal pin diameter as fraction of an inch
role_map.A_std_basic: pin diameter A basic, standard series (nominal + 0.0002)
role_map.A_std_max: pin diameter A max, standard series
role_map.A_std_min: pin diameter A min, standard series
role_map.A_os_basic: pin diameter A basic, oversize series (nominal + 0.001)
role_map.A_os_max: pin diameter A max, oversize series
role_map.A_os_min: pin diameter A min, oversize series

notes: Only the hardened ground machine dowel pin of ASME B18.8.2 is tabulated (Standard Series is the normal stock; Oversize Series is for repair). Fractions 5/64 and 5/32 are non-preferred sizes (shown in parentheses in some sources). Lengths are not part of this table (length tolerance +-0.010 in per vendor sheets). Taper pins and spring (roll/coiled) pins from the same standard are NOT covered. Sources engineersedge and amesweb look like copies of each other and were counted as one; row_support=3 is therefore the minimum for the oversize columns, standard-series columns have 4-5.

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched engineersedge, amesweb, fuller, hdw (HTML, all 200) and both PDFs. 15 rows x 11 cols x 4 HTML pages = 660 comparisons, 660/660 equal (engineersedge fraction+decimal cell split, fuller 3-size blocks, hdw transposed). RC PDF checked for 1/8..1 std series A/B/C/R: equal. Sanity script: A max/min = basic +-0.0001, oversize basic = std basic + 0.0008, std basic - d_nom = 0.0002, B max < A min, B max > B min, C max > R min, every column strictly increasing: all pass.
problems: Exactly 3 clusters for every cell (eng/ames, fuller, hdw) - zero slack; vendor PDFs do not count. hdw independence from engineersedge supported by its own divergent value (3/4 suggested hole min 0.7496 vs 0.7495 in engineersedge and RC PDF); fuller and hdw both print zero-stripped numbers (0.125, 0.02) but share no typo and different layout - kept separate.

fuller uses symbols d, d1, c, R instead of A, B, C, R; roles confirmed by position and by exact value equality with the A/B/C/R-labelled engineersedge and hdw ('Pin Diameter(A)', 'Point Diameter(B)', 'Crown Height', 'Crown Radius').

d_nom printed as 0.0781, 0.0938, 0.1562 (true 0.078125, 0.09375, 0.15625) - 'as printed' in all 4 sources, keep but note rounding; 5/64 and 5/32 are non-preferred sizes (fuller shows them in parentheses).
A_os_* = oversize series (A basic +0.0008 over standard) - role read from headers 'Oversize Series' in all four pages. Units inches confirmed.
baetrocnc exclusion (mislabelled max) agreed; single-shear and press-fit columns not kept (not needed).

standard_full: ASME B18.8.2 hardened ground machine dowel pins (Standard Series and Oversize Series)
